name: GiveFaq - Every Question Closed
description: All five questions in the resting, collapsed state — the one worth reviewing, because the band's argument is that a reader who has decided to give should meet the button rather than five paragraphs of caveats, and that only holds if the closed list is scannable at a glance. An open accordion would review a state a reader reaches deliberately, one item at a time. Built on native details and summary, so it works with JavaScript off, which on a page asking for money is the difference between an unanswered question and a closed tab.
